status_2026: Not moved. A 2022 law names Nusantara, in East Kalimantan, as the new capital, but the move takes effect only when the president signs a decree, and none has been issued. In May 2026 the Constitutional Court confirmed that Jakarta remains the capital until then; the government's stated aim is to make Nusantara the 'political capital' by 2028. Wikidata marks Nusantara's capital statement as deprecated.
